assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under reason code CO-97.
Reason code CO-97 states the service is bundled into another covered procedure.
The clinical indication note specifies that cardiac event monitoring is ordered to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias.
The clinical indication note specifies the monitoring is to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias contributing to recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The monitoring addresses the specific concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73 and I48.0.
